title: Private Family Social Media Platform
description:
This project is a private social networking platform designed exclusively for families. Inspired by the familiar interface of Facebook, it provides a secure and intimate space where only selected family members can connect, share, and preserve memories.

Key Features:

- Family Timeline: Members can post thoughts, feelings, photos, and updates in a chronological feed.
- Privacy & Exclusivity: Unlike public social media, access is restricted to approved family members only.
- Detailed Member Profiles: Each member can create a bio including:
- Education qualifications
- Relationships to other family members
- Date of birth
- Personal details and milestones
- Rich Media Sharing: Support for photos and other media to capture family moments.
- Interactive Engagement: Likes, comments, and reactions to strengthen family bonds.

Purpose:
The platform aims to serve as a digital family diary, fostering closer connections and preserving family history in a safe, private environment. It combines the usability of mainstream social media with the intimacy of a closed family circle.
